series.methodology: Distinct players active in the 24 hours up to each capture, from the stored per-capture rollups, averaged per time bucket. The busiest and quietest captures in the range are plotted at their true values so a bucket never flattens the real peak. Buckets are never narrower than the capture cadence; a capture whose 24h span a gap stretched past 36 hours is left out.
